snippet.title: “Mythic Yi”: A HD2D Turn-Based RPG
snippet.description: The game features HD-2D high-definition pixel art akin to Octopath Traveler, offering a deep adaptation of ancient Chinese mythology. Its turn-based combat incorporates strategic mechanics such as the Five Elements cycle, celestial phenomena. The store page is now live.
